features.context: Mongolian names are strongly gendered (e.g., -tsetseg [flower], -maa/-ee suffixes for women; Bat-, Erdene for men, though some are unisex)
Mongolia has a slightly female-skewed sex ratio (approx. 50.8% female, 49.2% male), so without other information, you'd predict 'female' slightly better than chance
Traditional dress (deel) and hair length provide strong signals (if phone or in-person)
Younger Mongolians (especially in Ulaanbaatar) are more likely to be familiar with non-binary gender categories, though explicit transgender/non-binary self-identification remains rare in surveys
